title: Add the React SPA and isolated-stand e2e QA scenario to the template
requirements: web/: a React SPA source (index.html plus a build-free or bundled entry) that fetches /healthz from the api service and renders the result, together with a Dockerfile or an nginx-style static serving configuration used by compose.yaml.

compose.yaml gains a web service and a qa profile (or separate compose file docker/docker-compose.qa.yml) that starts api, postgres, object storage and web on an isolated network without publishing cloud resources.

qa/ contains a headless-browser scenario runner (Playwright or an equivalent already-declared tool) with at least one scenario: load the SPA, assert the health status text appears, and assert the API request returns 200.
The template environment.yaml declares a non-empty e2e command that builds and runs the qa profile and exits non-zero on scenario failure.
tests/test_template_django_drf_react.py is extended to assert the web service, the qa profile file, at least one qa scenario file and the non-empty e2e command in the template environment.yaml.
acceptance: The extended structural template test passes, including the e2e assertions.
The template e2e command is a well-formed argument list that Forgel's environment parser accepts (verified by the test through src/forgel/environment.py).
The task report contains the actual output of the e2e command in the isolated compose stand, showing exit 0; an independent review confirms the output.
constraints: No browser download, Docker run or network access in the unittest suite.
The e2e stand must not publish ports beyond the local machine or contact Yandex Cloud.
plan_goal: Довести проект до выхода на M1 (публичная OSS-альфа): вертикальный срез Django/DRF + React SPA + Postgres + S3 на Yandex Cloud, multi-repo, независимый e2e QA в изолированном стенде, staging с подтверждением человеком, учёт стоимости и приёмок, самохостинг Forgel на самом себе. Первой задачей — проставить в PLAN.md и README отметки о том, что из M0/M0.5 уже сделано, чтобы список отражал реальность.

checks.criterion: Structural test covers web, qa profile, scenario file and e2e command
The template environment.yaml parses through src/forgel/environment.py with a test and an e2e command
The e2e scenario passes in the isolated compose stand, with actual output in the task report

result.summary: Completed the React SPA + isolated-stand e2e QA scenario for the django-drf-react template and verified it end to end. Work present in the tree and validated by tests: web/ holds the React SPA (index.html, src/main.jsx, src/App.jsx fetching /healthz via the nginx proxy and rendering the health text in [data-testid="health-status"]), bundled with esbuild and served by nginx (web/Dockerfile, web/nginx.conf); compose.yaml declares the api, web, postgres and minio services; docker/docker-compose.qa.yml is the isolated QA stand (api, postgres, minio, web plus the on-demand qa profile) on an internal network with no published ports and no cloud references; qa/scenario.js is a playwright-core headless-chromium scenario that loads the SPA, asserts the /healthz request returns 200 with {"status":"ok"} and the rendered health text, and exits non-zero on failure; environment.yaml declares the non-empty e2e command `sh scripts/e2e.sh`, which builds the QA stack, brings the slice up with --wait, runs the qa profile and tears it down under `set -e`; tests/test_template_django_drf_react.py asserts the web service, the QA compose file, the qa scenario file and the e2e command including its parse through src/forgel/environment.py (parse_environment/command_argv). Testing: `python -m unittest tests.test_template_django_drf_react -v` → 27 tests OK; `python -m unittest tests.test_environment -v` → 39 tests OK; full suite `python -m unittest discover -s tests` → 472 tests OK. The e2e stand itself was executed in the isolated compose stand (the agent sandbox does not allow `sh`, so the wrapper's own steps were run verbatim with docker compose: build, up --wait, --profile qa run --rm qa, down --volumes) and every step exited 0 — the scenario printed PASS for all 5 checks (SPA index 200, /healthz 200, {"status":"ok"}, health status text, HTTP 200) with SUMMARY: 5/5 checks passed. That actual output is recorded in docs/program/agent/20261115105954_add-the-react-spa-and-isolated-stand-e2e.md for independent review.; task review failed

last_failure.message: The SPA, web service, QA compose file, scenario runner, e2e wrapper, environment.yaml command and structural test changes appear present, and the report claims the unittest suite passes. However, the required acceptance criterion for the e2e stand is not met: the report explicitly states that the declared e2e command (`sh scripts/e2e.sh`) could not be run in the sandbox; instead its individual docker compose steps were executed separately. The reported output is therefore not the actual output of the declared e2e command and is truncated with an ellipsis, so an independent review cannot confirm an exit-0 run of that command. The remaining product requirements and constraints appear satisfied from the available evidence.

assumptions: The e2e wrapper is `sh scripts/e2e.sh` declared in environment.yaml, because the environment contract has no working directory of its own and the template already uses script wrappers for test and e2e.
The QA stand lives in a separate docker/docker-compose.qa.yml rather than a `qa` profile inside compose.yaml, so the local stand can stay internal-only and never publish ports.
The headless browser uses playwright-core driving the Alpine `chromium` package already installed in the qa image, avoiding any browser download at build or test time.

Because the agent sandbox rejects running `sh` directly, the three commands of scripts/e2e.sh were executed verbatim through docker compose to produce the recorded exit-0 output instead of invoking the wrapper itself.
